explanation: Julius Caesar led an unsuccessful invasion of Britain in 55 BC. Britain was not conquered until AD 43.

angles.q: In which year did Julius Caesar lead an unsuccessful invasion of Britain?

explanation: The Roman conquest of Britain began in AD 43 under Emperor Claudius, and most of Britain came under Roman control.

angles.q: Under which emperor did the Romans successfully conquer Britain?

angles.a: The Romans invaded and began their conquest

angles.e: Hadrian's Wall was built across northern England on the orders of Emperor Hadrian, and long stretches of it survive today.

explanation: Boudicca was queen of the Iceni and led a revolt against the Romans. Her statue stands on Westminster Bridge in London.

angles.q: Boudicca was the queen of which tribe?
Where in London does a statue of Boudicca stand?

explanation: The Roman army left Britain in AD 410 to defend other parts of the Roman Empire, and never returned.

angles.q: Why did the Roman army leave Britain in AD 410?
angles.a: To defend other parts of the Roman Empire
wrong: They were defeated by the Vikings
They were driven out by the Normans
The emperor lost interest in Britain

angles.q: How long did the Roman occupation of Britain last?

explanation: St Augustine led missionaries from Rome and became the first Archbishop of Canterbury. St Columba founded a monastery on Iona.

explanation: King Alfred the Great defeated the Vikings, though they were allowed to settle in the east and north of England in an area called the Danelaw.

angles.q: What was the name of the area of England where the Vikings were allowed to settle?

angles.q: Which Danish king ruled England in the 11th century?

angles.a: The towns and villages of England and who lived in them
wrong: The battles of the Norman Conquest

angles.q: In which year did the Black Death arrive in England?

angles.a: Demand higher wages, because workers were scarce
wrong: Be forced to work for nothing
Be forbidden to leave their village
Be taxed at a higher rate

angles.q: The Tudor rose combined the emblems of which two houses?

angles.q: Which of Henry VIII's wives was the mother of Edward VI?

angles.q: Which Church did Henry VIII establish?

angles.a: They were closed and their land and wealth taken
wrong: They were expanded and given more land
They were handed to the Pope

From which country did William of Orange come?

angles.q: In which year was the Bill of Rights passed?

angles.q: In which year was the Act of Union between England and Scotland?

angles.q: In which year was the Battle of Culloden?
